Commentary.Commentary: I believe the match is probably over! Chasing 279 against a side with Rashid Khan, Mujeeb Ur Rahman and a few other good bowlers, just don't see that happening. However, there are miracles which have happened in cricket but this probably is something a little too much. Join us to find out in the second innings how Ireland go along their innings.

Now then, when a team is smacked for something around 280 in 20 overs, there is not a lot you can write about their bowling. Boyd Rankin is the only one who has respectable figures. The rest have economy rates in double digits.

What better could have Afghan asked for after winning the toss and electing to bat. This team now holds the record for the highest T20I score in history. The only time Ireland were in the game were the first two overs where the two batsmen played out a few balls to get their eye in. Once they got an idea of the pace of the wicket, they went bonkers. It was raining boundaries out there, more from the bat of the southpaw. He smashed a 42-ball ton and then continued and stayed unbeaten till the end. A word of praise for Ghani as well, he was happy to play second fiddle but he too scored at a strike rate in excess of 150. Ireland did manage to pick a couple of wickets but they won't be happy with their overall effort.
Zazai walks off with a huge smile on his face. The Ireland players walk upto him and congratulate him. What an innings this has been. Just brutal, just brutal. 16 sixes and 11 fours tells the story.

EDGED AND FOUR! Ends the inning in style! Full and outside off, Zazai throws his bat at it, he tries to hit it as hard as possible. The ball takes the outside edge and races to the third man fence. AFGHANISTAN FINISH WITH 278 FOR 3!
Three good slower ones! Zadran once again is done in by the pace. It goes off the inner half towards long on for a run.
Another slower ball outside off, the batter swings hard but once again is done in by the slower one.
Najibullah Zadran is the new batsman in.
OUT! TIMBER! Nabi is out of here. The bowler has the last laugh. Lovely slower one, Nabi is foxed. He swings way too early and misses. The ball hits the middle stump.
SIX! Consecutive maximums! Short and down the leg side, Nabi pulls it over the short fine leg fielder and it goes over the fence. Are we in for another 24 or 25-run over?
SIX! What a shot to surpass the highest T20I score. Full and outside off, Nabi clears his front leg and just lofts it over the cover fence for a biggie. Ideal start to the last over.
Another inside edge! This one stays low however. Nabi tries to put bat on ball but gets an inside edge towards the leg side. A run taken.
Inside edge... FOUR! Short and outside off, Nabi looks to hit it on the leg side. He only manages to get an inside edge past the diving short fine leg fielder and into the fence.

OUT! Shafiqullah holes out! He had no option though, he had to go for it but falls in the attempt to do so. Slower ball and it is shorter in length. It is the batsman who has to get all the power behind it. He does hit it nicely but there is not enough power to get it over the ropes. It goes towards deep mid-wicket. Tucker there moves nicely to his left and take it.
A full toss outside off, Zazai fails to take full toll of it. He swings but it goes off the inner half through mid-wicket. He runs one quickly, wants a second but is rightly sent back by his partner.
Slower ball outside off, it is guided towards point and a run is taken.
SIX! THAT IS HUGE! Short delivery on middle, Shinwari pulls it over mid-wicket for a biggie. It goes over the deep mid-wicket fielder who jumps.

FOUR! 12 from the last three balls and 14 from the over. The second half of the over spoils it for the bowler. 12 from the last three. Short again, Zazai however, swivels and manages to pull it in the gap through backward square leg region.
Now a couple as he lofts this over covers.
SIX! Not sure with Zazai out there that will be possible! Short and on middle, Zazai is not troubled by the short ball, he pulls it over the square leg fence for a biggie.
Samiullah Shinwari is the new batsman in.

OUT! In the air... taken! Finally, Ireland have managed to breakthrough. The short ball does the trick for Rankin. It is short and on middle, Ghani makes room and looks to pull, he gets a top edge. It lobs towards long on. Little there runs across to his left and takes a very good catch. End of a very good innings by Ghani. He has played second fiddle but has done his part. Also that is the end of a 236-run stand. Can Ireland at least end well here?
On the pads, Zazai looks to swing but misses. It hits his pads and rolls towards cover. The batsmen take a leg bye.
Shorter in length, Ghani is a touch late in the pull, it goes off the higher portion and towards long on for a run.
Boyd Rankin is back.
SIX! MOST BY ANY BATSMAN IN T20IS! Number 15 for Zazai. Beats Aaron Finch's record of 14 vs England in Southampton. Another short ball and Hazratullah shows no mercy. Pummels it over square leg.
Full and outside off, lofted over covers for a run.
WIDE. Bowls it miles outside off, from around the wicket, left alone.
Full and well outside off, Zazai swings hard but gets a thick outside edge, just over short third man! A single taken. Wants the second but Ghani sends him back.
WIDE! Bowls it wide outside off, Zazai leaves it alone.
HAT-TRICK OF SIXES! Full and around middle and off, Hazratullah brings out the helicopter shot and it takes off, landing way over long off!
SIX! Back-to-back sixes for Hazratullah. Short delivery again, Zazai pulls it over mid-wicket for another biggie!
SIX! Another one. A short ball outside off, Zazai pulls it over mid-wicket for half a dozen!
Swing and a miss! A dot to end but still 14 has come off this over. Slower delivery again and outside off, Ghani dances down the track and swings wildly but only connects with thin air.
FOUR! Excellent use of the feet! Dances down the track, makes it a half volley and hits it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
This is lofted over covers and a run is taken.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman. Wide signalled by the umpire.

DROPPED AND SIX! It is over the ropes! Sums up Ireland's day. A tough chance yes, but that should have been taken. The slower length delivery, Zazai smacks it flat towards wide long on. The fielder there runs to his left and tries to take ti reverse cup while running. The ball though bursts through his hands and seems to go all the way. The umpire goes upstairs to check. Replays confirm the same. 200 up and they haven't lost a wicket. To add to that there are 4 more overs to go.
Zazai has been dropped but the umpire wants to check whether it has gone over the ropes or not?
WIDE! Bowls it wide outside off, Zazai lets it go.
Bowls a yorker on off, Zazai does well to dig it out.
Slower ball and full on off, Ghani lofts it over mid off for a single.
Shane Getkate is back on.
A single to end! A boundary-less over, not seen that a lot today. Slower ball and it is shorter in length. Ghani swings but it goes off the inner half towards deep mid-wicket for a run.

Well fielded! Just a run! Slower short ball, Zazai is a touch early into the stroke. He still drags it in the gap at the mid-wicket region. The fielder at long on runs to his left. slides and does well to save three for his side.
On the shorter side and outside off, Ghani slaps it down to long off and gets to the other end. Changing his length really well here is Kevin. Getting all his experience in play.
A yorker outside off, this is jammed out through covers for a run. Exactly the length you have to bowl.
The pressure is getting to Kevin. He bowls it way outside off, looking to keep it out of the reach of Zazai. He ends up bowling it too wide though. Wided.
Guides this through point and gets to the other end. Does the right thing by giving the strike to the man who is hitting every ball out of the park.
Down the leg side, Ghani swings but misses. Wided.
Starts off well here! Bowls it wide outside off, Ghani looks to hit it on the leg side but misses.
Kevin O'Brien is into the attack.
SIX! POWERFUL SHOT! Back of a length on middle and leg, in his zone, Zazai pulls it over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Length delivery on middle, Ghani moves across and pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Back of a length on off, Ghani moves across the line and looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Full again and outside off, Zazai drives it through mid off for a single.
Full and outside off, Ghani drives it towards covers for a run.
Full on middle and leg, Zazai flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Joshua Little is back into the attack.
Keeps strike in the next over by taking a single. 24 from Stirling's first and now the highest T20I score, 263 by Australia is under threat.

SIX! He does it with one ball remaining in this over. Another biggie. Takes his helmet off and raises his bat. He has a big smile on his face and why not. This is also the third fastest century in T20Is. Only the second man for Afghanistan to score a ton after Shahzad. Total carnage by him here. He gets a ball in his zone to get to the milestone. Full and outside off, it is smashed over the long off fence for a biggie.
A dot! A rarity! Full and outside off, Zazai hits it back to the bowler. 2 more balls to go in this over to bring up his ton.
Wide down the leg side, the batsman leaves it alone. The umpire has signalled a wide. 4 wides so far in this over.

SIX! This is just in his hitting zone. Short and on the pads, Zazai swivels and pulls it over the square leg fence for a maximum. He is one boundary away now. 3 balls to go in this over. Will he bring it up?
Hat-trick of wides as this is fired down the leg side.
Another wide as this one too is fired down the leg side.
Down the leg side, Zazai swings but misses. The keeper fails to collect it. The fielder at short fine leg does well to move across and stop it. Wide signaled.
Fires it outside off, Ghani hits it through point and takes a run.
SIX! All the way! Welcome into the attack, Stirling. The faster one by him, Ghani shuffles across and hits it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Paul Stirling is on now.
On the middle stump, Zazai works it through square leg. They run one, he wants a second. The fielder gets to the ball quickly and has a shy but misses. 150 up for Afghanistan.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On the ribs of the batsman, it is worked around the corner and a single is taken. The batsman gives it as a leg bye so there may not be any bat there.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Outside off, Ghani shows finesse this time as he waits for it and then guides it past the diving keeper for a boundary. Not sure if he wanted to get that so fine but he won't mind.

FOUR! The bowling change does not make a difference, the runs keep flowing. Once again the over starts with a boundary. Short and on the body, the batter swivels and pulls it all along the ground to the backward square leg fence.
Boyd Rankin is back.
Flighted delivery on middle, Ghani lofts it over mid on for a run. Another big over for Afghanistan. 16 runs came from it.
FOUR! This is poor bowling from Simi Singh. Full toss on middle, Ghani lofts it over mid on for a boundary. 15 runs have already come off the five balls.
WIDE! Bowls wide outside off, Ghani lets it go.
FOUR! Good shot. Floated on middle, Ghani lofts this over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tossed up on off, Zazai plays it towards mid off for a run.
FOUR! Nice shot. Short on middle, Zazai pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. What power this guy is having.
Short and outside off, Ghani cuts it towards point for a run.
Simi Singh is on now. Ireland trying everything here.
FOUR! Ends the over with a boundary! 20 from it and Zazai is into the 80s. Another full toss outside off, Zazai reaches out for it, somehow gets it over cover and into the fence.
SIX! Adding salt to the wound. Dropped on the previous ball he faced and now tonks this over mid-wicket for a biggie.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.

DROPPED! Things just keep getting worse for the visitors! Should have taken that. Dockrell is the man in question. Full and wide outside off, Zazai throws his bat at it. He ends up slicing it towards deep point. George there runs to his right, gets two hands to it but fails to hang on. The batsmen take a run. This could prove really costly. Afghanistan needed a wicket here.
WIDE! Full and wide outside off, Zazai leaves it alone.

SIX! THAT IS OUT OF THE GROUND! WHAT A SHOT! This guy hits it with some power! Another length ball and it sits up to be hit. Zazai loves rocking back and he pulls it over the backward square leg fence. The connection is such that the ball is out of the park.
Back of a length on middle, Ghani comes down the track and looks to play it back towards the bowler. It goes off the inner half of the bat towards mid-wicket. The batsmen take a run.

FOUR! This is just brute force! Another boundary through the long off region. Full and outside off, Zazai somehow manages to hit it through mid off. He gets a lot of power behind it and it races to the fence. 100 is also up, 11 more overs to go. 200-plus is on the cards.
Very full on off, Zazai smashes it back towards the bowler who makes a good stop.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Another full and wide delivery outside off, Zazai gets his bat to it and hits it down to long off for a run.
Fires it wide outside off, it is very wide and the umpire has his hands stretched.
Now a couple as Zazai slices it over covers. It is in the gap, an easy two.
FOUR! Powerful! A low full toss outside off, Zazai smashes it down the ground. The fielder at long off just had to move a little to his left but he had no chance.
Keeps strike by hitting this down to long on. Getkate has gone for 14 in his first and Afghanistan are on course for a huge total.

SIX! This time he pulls it watchfully and brings up his fifty. Short and on middle, Zazai pulls it over the mid-wicket fence. Raises his bat and soaks in the applause. His third in this format. A ton is on offer here.
Slower ball, Ghani hits it down to long on and gets to the other end. He is happy to play second fiddle at the moment.
Very full on the pads, it is flicked towards deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! He did not have his eyes open when he played that but it still went to the fence. Short and on the body, Zazai waits for it and pulls it through backward square leg for a boundary.
On the fuller side, Ghani shuffles right across and works it towards wide long on. He calls for two but has to settle for one.
Shane Getkate is on now.
Floated on middle, Ghani flicks it towards the leg side for a run. Another big over for Afghanistan. 11 runs came from it.
Full on off, Zazai drives it towards covers for a run.
SIX! Poor delivery from Dockrell. Short delivery, Zazai pulls it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Flighted delivery on middle and leg, Ghani flicks it towards square leg for a run.
Tossed up on middle, Zazai lofts it over wide mid on for a run.
Full on off, Ghani drives it towards mid off for a run.
George Dockrell is into the attack.

A dot to end but an expensive last over of the Powerplay! This is bowled on the pads, Zazai swings but misses. It hits his pads and rolls to the off side. Afghanistan's Powerplay without a doubt. They are 64 for 0 after it.
Goes for another yorker but this one is down the leg side. Wided.
If you bowl there not many batsman can put you away. A yorker on middle, Zazai jams it out.
SIX! 17 from the first 4 balls! One thing is for sure, you do not bowl slower ones to this guy. Another one, Zazai picks it quickly, he waits for it and then pulls it over mid-wicket for a maximum.

EDGY FOUR! Wide outside off, Zazai throws his bat at it, it takes the outside edge and flies to the third man fence. Afghanistan won't mind how they come as long as they come. 11 from the first three balls.
Slower ball, it is worked through mid-wicket for a run.
SIX! 50 is up in style! Another poor ball, short and down the leg side, Ghani swivels and pulls it over the fine leg ropes.
Joshua Little to bowl the last over of the Powerplay.

The last ball is a dot! Seam-up delivery, he follows the batsman. Zazai looks to flick but the ball hits his pad and rolls towards cover. Another over from Chase which goes for 15. He has gone for 30 in his 2.

FOUR! The helicopter shot! Another slower one and once again Zazai is waiting for it. He hits it uppishly but wide of the diving mid off fielder and into the fence. Another expensive over by Chase this. A ball to go still.
SIX! Zazai has picked the bones out of that one. Slower one on middle, he waits for it and hits it over long on. There was a fielder there but the batsman does not care.
Good length around off, the ball seems to have come slow off the surface. Ghani checks his shot and it goes towards mid on for a run.
Corrects his line and bowls it outside off, it is guided to point.
FOUR! Poor bowling! Fine leg is up in the ring and you serve it on the pads, easy for a batsman. Ghani helps it on its way to the fine leg fence. Once again an over starts with a boundary.

A little too straight, Zazai looks to play it fine but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls towards the leg side. Zazai wants a run but his partner sends him back. A good comeback by the bowler after going for a biggie on the first ball.
On a length again, this is worked through square leg for an easy run.
The physio is out to have a look. Also, the magic spray is out. The spray does its job and Ghani is all fine to continue.
On the shorter side, Ghani is a little hurried into the pull.It goes off his arm towards point.
Zazai makes room, the bowler follows him. Zazai works it towards square leg and takes a run.
Good batting! Sees the length is dragged back, he pushes it to mid on and gets to the other end.

SIX! First of the game for Ghani! On the stumps and the ball is on a fuller length. Easy pickings for Ghani. He flicks it with his back leg in the air and into the mid-wicket stands. Ideal start to the over, pressure on the bowler.
Well bowled! A dot to end but still a very expensive over, 15 from it. The slower ball and it is very full. Zazai hits it towards mid off. The fielder there fumbles but no extra runs conceded.
FOUR! This keeps getting better for Afghanistan. Another ball which is right in the zone for Zazai. Full and on middle, he lofts it over mid on for a one bounce boundary.
SIX! Zazai gets into the act! Length ball, Zazai clears his front leg and tonks it over the long on fence. Already an expensive over this, still 2 balls to go.
A single to follow the boundary as Ghani strokes it to mid off.
FOUR! Just over! Uses his feet and gets to the pitch of it. He whips it just over the outstretched hand of mid on and a boundary. First off the bat of Ghani.
Leading edge! Some swing there for Chase. Full and on middle, it shapes away a little. Ghani plays it with a closed face bat. He gets a leading edge to mid off.
Peter Chase is on now.
End of a very good first by Rankin. Just a couple from it. Ghani pulls this nicely towards deep square leg for a run. Watchful start by Afghanistan.
Another dot! This is a good over till now by Rankin. Back of a length on off, Ghani guides it to point.

Hesitation but safe in the end! Ghani taps this towards point and wants a run. The fielder there gets to the ball quickly and Zazai sends his partner back. The fielder has a shy but misses. Ghani would have been in I feel had that hit the stumps.
On the fuller side, Ghani flicks it stylishly but finds the fielder at mid on.
Good length and around off, Ghani lunges and keeps it out.
Starts off with a delivery down the leg side, the batter looks to flick but it hits his pads and rolls towards square leg. Another leg bye taken, consecutive leg byes for Afghanistan.
We are back! Not a long delay. The groundsmen have done their job.

Now, what has happened there? The sprinkler may have been turned on and there is water sprinkling on the field. A slight halt in play. The players are now seen walking off as there were a few wet patches out there.
Boyd Rankin to bowl from the other end.
A single to end! On the pads, Zazai looks to flick, the ball brushes his pads and rolls towards fine leg. A leg bye.
Short again, Zazai hops and cuts it to point. He tried to play that all along the ground, had he taken the aerial route, could have got a boundary.
This one stays a touch low! Outside off, Zazai looks to cut but due to the low bounce he ends up chopping it to covers.
FOUR! Up and over! Off the mark in style is Zazai. Slightly fuller, HZ clears his front leg and tonks it over mid on. It bounces once before crossing the rope.
Drags his length back and bowls it on off, Zazai with no foot movement defends it out.
Right on the money to begin with. On a length and around off, Zazai is half-forward as he pushes it to covers.
We are all set for the game to begin. Usman Ghani and Hazratullah Zazai to open the innings for Afghanistan. Joshua Little to bowl the first over for Ireland.

Pitch report - Niall O'Brien with the pitch report feels that it is a completely different pitch from the previous game. He says this surface is hard and it has no live grass on it. O'Brien expects the pitch to have more spin and offer no seam movement for the pacers. Expects the captain winning the toss to bat first.

Ireland skipper, Paul Stirling says that he wanted to bowl first. Adds that you have to be at your best throughout the game if you need to beat Afghanistan. Informs that Lorcan Tucker comes in for the injured Stuart Thompson.

Afghanistan skipper, Asghar Afghan, says the grass looks dry and the spinner will come into play as the game progresses. Mentions they will try their best today and look to beat them. Informs that Sharafuddin Ashraf misses out tonight, being replaced by Usman Ghani.

Najibullah Zadran who is up for an interview says he played his natural game and he wanted to form a partnership with Nabi. Mentions they were targeting the last 5 overs, till then they were looking to play themselves in. Ends by saying Afghan will continue to open as he did well in the practice game.
Toss - Afghanistan have won the toss and they will bat first.

The first T20I ended as expected, the hosts came out on top. It is now time for the second one in Dehradun. A must-win for the visitors if they are to stay alive in the series. The home side on the other hand, will look to seal it here itself. We saw the Windies upset the English, the Lankans upsetting the South Africans, will the Irish upset the Afghans? We'll have to wait to find out. Stay tuned for the toss and teams in a while.
